gridPlan.scope: Adults (18+) only. Children and teenagers are intentionally excluded for the hackathon.
rules: Every cell is a distinct synthetic person with a fictional face; no real people, no reference photos.
Same pose, framing, clothing and background across the grid so try-on results are comparable.
Generate only the cells users actually land in most often first (M/L, medium height, neutral), then widen.
Not every axis combination is needed: 2 x 6 x 3 x 4 = 144 cells is the ceiling; a first useful library is roughly 12-20 images.
